# A `lot_owner:` split on a transaction that is refused a line later.
#
# Attaching a lot owner makes a lot, and it makes it while the transaction is
# still being built. The build then hits a figure the currency cannot hold and
# the transaction is destroyed — so the question is whether the lot goes with
# it, or stays behind empty and owner-attached, which per this repo's own
# findings is indistinguishable from a parked credit.
#
# A second, ordinary transaction is here on purpose: without one the run has
# nothing to save and the question never reaches the file.
#
# What this fixture produces: one error naming 18.191, one transaction
# imported, and `find-prepayments` reporting no open credit.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_refused_figure_leaves_no_wreckage.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

customer "C-LOT"
	name: "Lot Customer"
	currency: CAD

2026-02-01 * "An ordinary sale"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank 40.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Income:Sales -40.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2026-02-02 * "A deposit whose second line will not do"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Accounts Receivable -25.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		lot_owner: "customer:C-LOT"
	Assets:Bank 25.001 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
